title: Austin Housing: Marshall Apts & Privacy Rules
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Approved up to $6 million in revenue bonds to support new affordable housing initiatives.
*   Specifically authorized funding for the acquisition and rehabilitation of the Marshall Apartments on East 12th Street and Salina Street, boosting local affordable housing options.
*   Adopted a new Customer Privacy Assurance Program to safeguard sensitive information for individuals served by the Housing Finance Corporation.
